title: Tiny voltage-weighted occupation can coexist with nonrare Gibbs mass
statement: Translated4R squares with four R-box Ferrers corner cuts, arbitrary positive interior thermal magnetization and stated small exterior gas form disjoint source envelopes. Ordinary-interior FKG, full-domain flips and weighted energy-norm aggregation pay all thermal bits and contour collisions. The source derives N_G/ZA<=sqrt[(C/ZA)K_F], including partition-product entropy. At R80/200/1000/10000 bounds are exp(-612/-1703/-9047/-91930), while same non-target core-normalized mass is at least n/3 for the first three and n/6 last. This is a restricted family, not complete entrance or residence coverage.
